# Workspace actions

The workspace plane is the customer's own Cbox account, above every environment it owns: projects, environments (and their custom domains), the team, workspace keys and the keys of each environment. It is served on the platform root and resolves no environment.

Every row below is one action, reached through four doors that run the same code, with the same authorization, validation, approvals and [Audit log](../guides/activity-log.md) entry: the console, the REST API, the MCP server and the `cbox` CLI. See [Actions](../core-concepts/actions.md) for how that works and [Planes and hosts](../core-concepts/planes-and-hosts.md) for where each plane is served.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `https://<root-host>/api/v1/workspace/…` with `Authorization: Bearer cbid_ws_…` (a workspace key, whose role must also allow the action), or a team member's token from the root |
| MCP | `/mcp` on the platform root, signed in as a member of the workspace's team, or with a workspace key |
| CLI | `cbox login` at the root, then the command below |
| OpenAPI | `/api/v1/workspace/openapi.yaml` on the host above — public, no key needed ([source](https://github.com/cboxdk/cbox-id/blob/main/resources/openapi/workspace.yaml)); every operation carries `x-action`, `x-scope` and `x-danger` |

Danger is how much harm the action can do in the wrong hands: `read` only reads; `write` changes something another write can undo; `destructive` removes or revokes; `critical` mints credentials, takes over access or changes how people sign in. MCP clients are told a destructive or critical tool is destructive, the CLI asks before running one, and an [approval policy](../core-concepts/approvals.md) keys on it.

## Environments

### <a id="environments.create"></a>environments.create

Create an environment under one of the workspace's projects; with `initial_key`, also mint its first management key, returned once as `initial_key.token`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/workspace/environments` → `201` |
| Scope | `environments:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `environments_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments create` |
| Secret | `data.initial_key.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `type` | string | no | Default `production`. One of `production`, `sandbox`. |
| `project_id` | string | no | The project (billing anchor) to create it under. Defaults to the workspace's first project. At most 64 characters. |
| `initial_key` | object | no | Mint the environment's first management key in the same call. Its value is returned once, as `initial_key.token`. |
| `initial_key.name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `initial_key.scopes` | list of string | yes | The environment-key scopes it carries, for example `apis:write`. At least 1 items. At most 64 items. |
| `initial_key.expires_at` | string (date-time), nullable | no | When it stops working. Left out, it does not expire. |

### <a id="environments.domain.remove"></a>environments.domain.remove

Stop serving one of the workspace's environments on its custom domain. Anything using that domain stops reaching it.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/domain` → `204` |
| Scope | `environments:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `environments_domain_remove` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments domain remove <environment_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |

### <a id="environments.domain.request"></a>environments.domain.request

Start serving one of the workspace's environments on a custom domain: returns the DNS TXT record that proves you control it.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/domain` → `200` |
| Scope | `environments:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `environments_domain_request` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments domain request <environment_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `domain` | string | yes | The domain, for example login.example.com. At most 253 characters. |

### <a id="environments.domain.verify"></a>environments.domain.verify

Look for the pending domain's DNS TXT record and, once it is visible, serve the environment on that domain.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/domain/verify` → `200` |
| Scope | `environments:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `environments_domain_verify` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments domain verify <environment_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |

### <a id="environments.list"></a>environments.list

List every environment the workspace owns, across its projects, with each one's issuer.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/workspace/environments` → `200` |
| Scope | `workspace:read` — (any role). |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `environments_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `page` | integer | no | The page to read, from 1. A list says `next_page` when there is one. |

## Keys

### <a id="keys.environment.create"></a>keys.environment.create

Mint a management key for one of the workspace's environments, with the scopes it needs. The value is returned once, as `token`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/keys` → `201` |
| Scope | `keys:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `keys_environment_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys environment create <environment_id>` |
| Secret | `data.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `scopes` | list of string | yes | The environment-key scopes it carries, for example `apis:write`. At least 1 items. At most 64 items. |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time), nullable | no | When it stops working. Left out, it does not expire. |

### <a id="keys.environment.revoke"></a>keys.environment.revoke

Revoke one of an environment's management keys; whatever uses it stops immediately.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/keys/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `keys:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `keys_environment_revoke` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys environment revoke <environment_id> <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |

### <a id="keys.workspace.create"></a>keys.workspace.create

Mint a workspace key with a role and optional scopes, never wider than the caller. The value is returned once, as `token`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/workspace/keys` → `201` |
| Scope | `keys:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments` and `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `keys_workspace_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys workspace create` |
| Secret | `data.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `role` | string | yes | One of `admin`, `developer`, `member`, `viewer`. |
| `scopes` | list of string, nullable | no | Narrow the key below its role. Left out, the role alone bounds it — or, minted by a key with scopes, that key's scopes. At least 1 items. |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time), nullable | no | When it stops working. Left out, it does not expire — or, minted by a key that does, expires with it. |

### <a id="keys.workspace.list"></a>keys.workspace.list

List the workspace's keys, newest first, revoked ones included — names, roles, scopes and expiry, never their values.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/workspace/keys` → `200` |
| Scope | `workspace:read` — and a role that may `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `keys_workspace_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys workspace list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `page` | integer | no | The page to read, from 1. A list says `next_page` when there is one. |

### <a id="keys.workspace.revoke"></a>keys.workspace.revoke

Revoke a workspace key, and every key it minted on either plane (workspace keys and environment management keys, all the way down); whatever uses them stops immediately.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/workspace/keys/{id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `keys:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments` and `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `keys_workspace_revoke` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys workspace revoke <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |

## Projects

### <a id="projects.create"></a>projects.create

Create a project: another independently-billed IdP product, with its own environment allowance.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/workspace/projects` → `201` |
| Scope | `projects:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `projects_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id projects create` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `environment_limit` | integer | no | This project's plan environment allowance (default 2). At least 1. At most 100. |

### <a id="projects.list"></a>projects.list

List the workspace's projects (IdP products), each with its environment allowance and how much of it is used.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/workspace/projects` → `200` |
| Scope | `workspace:read` — (any role). |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `projects_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id projects list` |

Takes no input.

|---|---|

| Scope | `projects:write` — and a role that may `manage-environments`. |

| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |

## Team

### <a id="team.environment_access"></a>team.environment_access

Set which of the workspace's environments a team member reaches: all of them, or the listed ones.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `PUT /api/v1/workspace/members/{id}/access` → `200` |
| Scope | `team:write` — and a role that may `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `team_environment_access` |
| CLI | `cbox id team environment_access <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `all_environments` | boolean | yes | True: every environment, including ones created later. |
| `environment_ids` | list of string | no | With `all_environments` false: the environments they reach. |

### <a id="team.invitations.list"></a>team.invitations.list

List the team's pending invitations, newest first.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/workspace/invitations` → `200` |
| Scope | `team:read` — and a role that may `read-members`. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `team_invitations_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id team invitations list` |

Takes no input.

|---|---|

| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |

| MCP tool | `team_invite` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `name` | string, nullable | no | At most 120 characters. |
| `role` | string | yes | One of `admin`, `developer`, `member`, `viewer`. |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |

### <a id="team.role"></a>team.role

|---|---|---|---|

### <a id="team.transfer_ownership"></a>team.transfer_ownership

Make another member the workspace's owner; the current owner stays on as an admin. Only the owner, signed in, may do this.
